parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` reflects two distinct test scenarios — a missing override/flag path and an invalid feature-flag fallback path — that intentionally exercise different code paths against the same production behaviour. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the distinct preconditions each test is asserting and reduce diagnostic clarity when either fails.
